metadata.title: DonutSMP-style custom item economy
metadata.warning: Custom balancing draft. Not official DonutSMP /sell values. Review before using as a production economy.
metadata.pricing_model: final_value = base_value + sum(enchantment bonus_per_level * enchantment level); incompatible enchantments and invalid levels should be rejected.
metadata.scale: every price of the original draft multiplied by 10

enchantment_rules.calculation: Add each applicable enchantment's bonus_per_level multiplied by its level to the item's base_value. Curse bonuses are negative. Do not apply rules to incompatible item types.
enchantment_rules.rounding: Round final value to 2 decimal places.
